report_discrepancies.note: Capital Projects Fund budget schedule: printed Total charges to appropriations 443,599 but its printed lines (Public works 182 + Environment and leisure 4,048 + Capital outlay 220,954) add to 225,184. The 218,415 gap equals the Capital Projects 'Economic and community development' expenditure on the governmental funds statement (p5), which the schedule does not print as a line.

notes: GAAP (modified accrual governmental funds). Governmental receipts/disbursements/fund balances from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (p5) Total Governmental Funds column; beginning_cash not shown. ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents on the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4) total 2,939,593; CDs 1,030,331 = ending_investments; county treasurer cash 53,122 separate. Transfers: one net Transfers from (to) other funds (293,870) out (Sales Tax 17,108 + Debt Service 276,762), matching Sewer Fund transfers in 293,870 (p7). Business-type from p7 total column; disbursements = operating 937,408 + interest 11,805. Proprietary cash flows p8 (no investing section). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position p1 (Unavailable revenue printed under liabilities). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement pp14-17 (20 departments; supersedes the General Fund budget schedule p9, not recorded); department functions follow the p5 General Fund function columns (Cemetery in public works, Senior in environment and leisure, Grants/Equipment/Employee Insurance in general government; all tie). Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service, Capital Projects from their budget schedules (pp10-13, budgetary basis, differ from p5). Keno and proprietary funds have no schedule. Read pages 1-17 of 17
